children: Catcher Predict monitoring showed sharp volatility in the Polymarket submarket for the San Diego Padres vs. Milwaukee Brewers event. According to ChainCatcher, the San Diego Padres option rose from 24.5% one hour earlier to 43.5% at the time of reporting, a 19 percentage point increase. The article said related breaking news may have influenced the move.

title: Polymarket Padres Option Jumps to 43.5% in Brewers Matchup Market
